title: Adapter block (the fenced discover-adapter JSON in adapters/<project-id>.md)

project.description: The project ID: the registry entry's file name.

as_of.description: The commit the adapter describes. Donors compare the paths it names against this commit to spot drift.

paths.description: Repo paths the adapter relies on, checked for changes since as_of.commit.

manifest.description: Where things live, in discover.json's shape. Used only while the repo has no discover.json.

frontier_doc.description: Where the project states its current result when it isn't (only) machine-readable. Stands in for the manifest's frontier for listing.

note.description: How to read it, in the project's own terms.

visual.description: The hero picture on the project's card and page, used when its manifest declares none (spec §4, Visual).

render.description: image: a picture the project keeps. progress: the frontier's value over time. bound-gap: the same, against the proven bound and a baseline. records: the record table as a grid of cases, open and settled. The hub draws the last three from the frontier record.

kind.description: witness: the picture is the result itself (a packing, a ruler). derived: computed from the frontier (a chart). illustration: conveys the topic only. Defaults: derived for drawn renders, illustration for images.

src.description: image: path of an SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF, at most 1 MB.

alt.description: What the picture shows, for readers who can't see it. Required for images.

baseline.description: bound-gap: where the question started, e.g. the bound before the project.

prompt.description: image: the image-generation prompt it was made from, a template filled from the frontier: {title}, {statement}, {metric}, {value}. Shown beside the picture; regenerate the image when the frontier changes.

from.description: Where src lives: the project's repository (default), or the hub's, e.g. visuals/<project-id>.png, for a picture the hub made.

frontier_adapter.description: Maps the repo's own results record onto frontier fields: {v0_field: raw_field}, plus metric, a declared evidence_level and claim_kind, and history (a path in the repo), and optionally select {list, key, current} to read the entry a registry's current field names.
